svg.title: GitHub Actions to EC2 deployment architecture
svg.desc: Flowchart showing how a push to GitHub triggers a workflow that zips files, uploads to S3, then SSM deploys to EC2 with Nginx serving the site

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What triggers the GitHub Actions workflow?')
sendPrompt('How does GitHub Actions trigger on a push?')
sendPrompt('Why is S3 used as a staging bucket?')
sendPrompt('What does the EC2 instance do during deployment?')
sendPrompt('How does the user access the deployed website?')
